items.prompt: Under the stated fee-expensed average-cost policy, selling 5 at 1300 from average 1100 realizes how much GROSS PnL?

options.text: 6500 cents, equal to all sale proceeds
options.why: Proceeds include recovery of the matched cost basis.

options.text: 1000 cents before the separately expensed fee
options.why: Five times the 200 cent price gain is 1000.
That is cost recovery, not profit.

options.text: It depends only on the current mark 1250
options.why: Realized gross gain here uses the closing execution price.

items.explanation: Realized gross PnL=closed quantity*(exit-average entry)*old-side sign.
